messages.subject: Re: Return order number L40246 delivered Nov. 17
messages.text:
Hi Heather,
 

 We have received your message and are doing our utmost to respond and assist you as quickly as possible. It's a busy time for messages, and our customer service team is still quite small: just 1 full-time person and me, who helps out occasionally amidst my dozens of other tasks!
 

 Rest assured, however, that your situation will not be overlooked, and we will take care of it as soon as possible. It is understood that the return period applies from the time the customer notifies us of a desire to make an exchange or a refund, not from when we have time to respond. Serving our customers well is a high priority for us, even if we are sometimes a bit overwhelmed.
 

 In short, we haven't forgotten about you and we're working hard to not let you down!

messages.subject: Re: Return order number L40246 delivered Nov. 17
messages.text:
Hello Heather,
 

 We're sorry to hear that the mittens do not suit you.
 

 Here are the steps to follow for a return/exchange: 
 

 1. Go to https://lasclay.happyreturns.com/ to obtain a return label. After entering your order number and zip code, you need to select the products you want to return and then choose the ones you want in replacement. At the end, you will receive a prepaid return label.
 

 2. Print the label, pack up the products to return and stick the label on the package. Please prefer using envelopes/bags rather than boxes, which are more expensive.
 

 3. Drop it off at a Canada Post red box or at the nearest post office.
 

 4. Once the return is received, if applicable, we will apply a $9.99 return fee.
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Catherine 
 

 Lasclay
